coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass completed: 17 actual search invocations and 148 captured result headers across English and local languages, sectors, local outlets, date windows, calendar boundaries and retrospective official/human-rights monitoring searches. Targeted UN/UNAMA/OHCHR and HRW/Amnesty searches were attempted. Results were mostly irrelevant or broad; a World Report header does not establish month-specific events. Many results were historical/unrelated. No candidate is verified from permitted article-body evidence; this is not an absence claim. Body reads=0; unresolved leads, access restrictions, search-vs-Lexis coverage and baseline review remain documented.
